info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Delete P2m By Outlet Id-spec
info.description: This API allows for the removal of payment methods associated with a specific outlet. It is designed to help businesses effectively manage their payment options by facilitating the deletion of outdated or unnecessary payment methods. Typically used by financial administrators or developers within an organization, this endpoint ensures that the outlet's payment configurations remain accurate and current. By using this API, users can streamline payment management and enhance operational efficiency.

delete.summary: Remove an outlet by its identifier.
delete.description: This endpoint allows you to delete an outlet from the system using its unique identifier. Ensure that the outlet ID is correct as this action is irreversible.

requestBody.description: Request body for deleting an outlet identified by RES-100045. It contains necessary parameters for the deletion operation.

204.description: Request completed successfully with no content returned.
